top_signals.title: Oil Breaks $100—and This Rally Has Legs
top_signals.summary: For months, crude oil prices have been constrained by reports of improving tanker traffic in the Strait of Hormuz. Even after the June ceasefire between Iran and the United States collapsed, tankers moving in and out of Hormuz have been moving at rates higher than in the spring. This has now changed with the latest escalation in the chokepoint, sending Brent crude above $100 per barrel on Wednesday morning. For months, analysts have been warning that Brent crude could surge to over $100 per barrel and stay there for an extended period of time.…
